可以在 设置 → 通用 → 桌面 里再打开。: Turn it back on in Settings → General → Desktop.

回到操作前的状态；已经手动改好的冲突内容不会保留。: Returns to the state before the operation; conflict edits you made will not be kept.

图片会保存到项目目录。: The image is saved in the project folder.

在对应项目的侧栏里，点开就能继续。: They are in their projects' lists, ready to continue.

在电脑上右键回复或会话就能存进来。: Right-click a reply or a session on the computer to save it here.
在电脑端打开 设置 → 远程，启用后扫码或复制连接链接；局域网、Tailscal: Open Settings → Remote on the desktop, turn it on, then scan or copy the link; LAN, Tailscale, EasyTier and the relay all work.
在电脑端点「添加工作区」，或者在这里填一个文件夹。: Add a workspace on the computer, or type a folder here.
在电脑端的命令面板里新建一个，手机上可以开关和手动跑一次。: Create one from the computer's command palette; here you can switch it and run it once.
在终端里登录 pi，或在这里添加一个 API key。: Log in to pi in a terminal, or add an API key here.
在输入框的模型菜单里点星标收藏；收藏的模型排在最前，可在这里调顺序。: Star a model in the composer's model menu; favourites come first, and their order is set here.
在输入框里续写草稿的下一句。: Continue the composer's draft with its next sentence.
在项目下显示终端里 pi 用过的会话，点开即继续。: Show the sessions pi used in a terminal under their project; open one to continue it.

填一个索引链接，加载后就能安装。索引是 {skills:[{id,name,ur: Fill in an index link; skills install with one click. The index is {skills:[{id,name,url}]} or an array, each url pointing at a SKILL.md.
填一个索引链接，加载后就能导入。索引是 {packs:[{id,name,url: Fill in an index link; packs import with one click. The index is {packs:[{id,name,url}]} or an array.

它的文件在 pi 的目录里，应用不删它；可以在文件管理器里处理。: Its file lives in pi's folder; the app does not delete it. Use the file manager.
它的项目目录不在本机。: Its project folder is not on this machine.

对话正文与输入框占聊天区宽度的比例；窄一些更好读，100% 铺满。: Share of the chat area the transcript and composer take; narrower reads better, 100% fills it.

崩溃日志没能写入。: The crash log could not be written.

已切回普通模式，可以接着聊。: Carry on chatting, or leave goal mode.

带上当前会话最近的上下文: Carry the main conversation's recent context

应用在运行结束前退出: The app quit before this run finished

弹出会恢复并从列表移除；应用保留条目；删除只移除条目。: Pop restores and removes the entry; Apply keeps it; Delete removes it alone.
快速打开会在项目里找文件。: Quick open looks for files in the project.
所有打开的文件都已保存。: Every open file is already saved.

手机端连接时需要；重新生成会让旧手机失效。: Required to connect a mobile client. Regenerating it invalidates previous connections.
手机连接地址里的端口，需在防火墙中放行。: The port in the mobile connection address must be allowed through the firewall.
打不开提交链接: Could not open the commit link

打开会话或终端后会出现在这里。: Sessions and terminals appear here once they run.

把一段工作方式放在每个提问前面；内置、自定义与插件带来的智能体都能管理，ACP: Put an instruction before every prompt; manage built-in, custom and plugin agents, and ACP sessions work the same way.
把一轮完成的消息发到飞书群。: Post finished turns to a Feishu group.
把上一条提问放回输入框: Put previous prompt back in the composer
把上一次提交放回暂存区（git reset --soft HEAD~1），文件内: Moves the last commit back to the index (git reset --soft HEAD~1); the files stay as they are.
把回答发回群: Send the answer back to the group
把当前配色、tokens、字体与圆角写成一个主题文件，可分享或继续改。: Write the current colors, tokens, fonts and radius as a theme file to share or edit.
把提问放回输入框: Put the prompt back in the composer
把整段对话放进剪贴板。: Put the whole conversation on the clipboard.

按 cron 在后台开始新会话并发送提示词；可选 pi 或 ACP，运行记录写进: Start a new session and send a prompt on a cron schedule; pick pi or ACP, and run history goes to tasks.json in the data folder.

按结构与数据流讲清一段代码怎么工作。: Explains code by structure and data flow.
按计划执行第 %d/%d 步，只做这一步，完成后停下：: Run step %d of %d from the plan; only this step, then stop.

换个词试试，或者新建一个会话。: Try another word, or start a new session.
描述会插到输入框里。: The description goes into the composer.
提交说明（第一行是标题）: Commit message (first line is the title)

插件给命令面板加命令，给外观加主题。: Plugins add commands to the palette and themes to the look.
插件给命令面板加提示词，给外观加主题。: Plugins add commands to the palette and themes to the look.

搜索所有会话的标题与内容…: Search every session's title and text…
